homeText1: 2023. June 14-18. Hot summer breeze. Vibrant lights at night. Drinks to cool you off. Music, dance, rhythm, water, and fire.
homeText2: Welcome to Vibe City, a bustling city where the atmosphere, fuss, lights, and symbols of the 80s and the 90s are making a comeback. It all takes place in the form of a summer music festival that will banish the silence from the shores of Lake Velence for 5 days and turn the night into day. Take part in the nostalgia, the endless fun, and the adventure!
homeText3: The "Örli Försztivál" is Hungary's summer, multi-day, furry subcultural meet, which takes place every year in June. In 2023, this event will come to life for the fifth time in Gárdony, a town on the shores of Lake Velence in Fejér County. This year, the venue, which can accommodate up to 150 people, will welcome furry participants for 5 days and provide active relaxation for all.
homeText4: The theme of this year's meet is "Vibe City", inspired by a popular action-adventure game with bright colors and cheerful landscapes, evoking the atmosphere of the 80s Miami.
homeText5: Does the name sound familiar? If it's new to you, give it some time by getting to know the meet and its rules. Have a look around the site!
locMapOpen: Click here to open Google Maps.
locEventC1: As in previous years, this year's Försztivál will be hosted at Pákász Tanya. This resort is based around trees and is perfectly suited to the needs of our festival city in terms of location, layout, buildings, and facilities. More than 5,000 square metres are ready for partying and relaxing; barbecues, well equipped kitchens, fridges, swing beds, table foosball, ping-pong, and even a jacuzzi will offer our attendees an unforgettable experience. For the additional convenience of those arriving by vehicle, there are parking spaces provided as well as a bicycle storage. The beach is directly accessible from the property and offers additional opportunities during its opening hours.

locAccom1: The meet venue offers a variety of different overnight options, whether you're a party animal at night or someone who wants to sleep in quiet. Coming from the nature of the place you can expect nostalgic camping conditions, but there are also plenty of things to keep our guests comfortable. The dormitory rooms can only be recommended for sleeping and relaxing purposes due to their size, but the communal areas are perfect for socializing activities. Each room comes with a limited amount of keys, which are subject to a substantial five-figure compensation (in HUF) if lost, so please take good care of them!
locAccom2: Rooms can only be occupied from 2:00 PM on the day of your arrival. Exceptions to this are Day Zero, where you can only occupy your room from 4:00 PM; and tent pitches, which can be taken at any time after your arrival.
locAccom3: As an important notice, room booking is only available for guests who are attending for several days at least. For one-night stays
locAccom4: Room reservation will only be available after your registration and the payment of your chosen package is done and processed, meaning that the fastest people can book their room first.

locGetting1L1: Coming from the M7/E71 Motorway, take Exit 57 and continue on Main Road 7 towards Agárd. After 5.8 kms turn left towards "Lake Velence". Arrival is after 2,5 kms. Your destination is on the left.
locGetting1L2: Arriving on Main Road 7, take a turn at a traffic light in the centre of Agárd (at the Nádas restaurant) in the direction of the railway station and across the railway crossing. Turn left and you will arrive after 1,6 kms. Your destination is on the right.
locGetting2L1: The nearest bus stop is called Agárd, Nádas Restaurant, which can be reached via the local buses.
locGetting2L2: From the drop-off point, head in the direction of the railway station / Lake Velence, across the railway and continue left along Chernel István road, you will arrive 1.5 kms later.
locGetting3L1: The nearest train station is called Agárd.
locGetting3L2: From the station, continue left along Chernel István road and you will arrive after 1.5 kms.
locGetting4L1: The nearest port is the Agárd, Boat Station.
locGetting4L2: As the starting point for the boat services here are the very same as their arrival, this transport method is not recommended. :)
locGetting5L1: The nearest international airport is Budapest, Liszt Ferenc Airport.
locGetting5L2: Access to the location by public transport can be seen above.
locGetting5L3: From Budapest, the site can be reached by bus from Népliget Bus Station, or by train coming from Déli Railway Station or Kelenföld Railway Station.

Meet the organizers, artists, programmers, the tech behind all this and everyone else who is helping to make this peaceful chaos happen!

priceIntro: We've tried to give a wide range of opportunities for everyone when it comes to visiting the event, whether if it's just for a few hours or for the entirety of the Försztivál!
priceIntro2: You can find out more about the different packages and their contents below.
priceEarlyText: Don't delay, because if you choose a package before the midnight of May 14, we'll give you a 15% discount off the price!
priceOutro1: Participation in each panel is subject to the purchase of an entry ticket, with no further additional cost. However, there are some optional programs that are handled by external service providers, so their fees may be an additional cost for participants. More information on this can be found under the

priceOutro5: We kindly ask you to prepare the appropriate banknotes of cash for a smooth check-in.
